reasoning: On the season so far the Mavericks are the stronger team; with home court the Mavericks start about 7 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Jazz.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (revenge).
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 62 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
